title: GitHub Issues, Discussions & Team Workflows
introduction: Writing code is only half the job in software development. Great projects need planning, bug tracking, feature roadmaps, and community communication. Today you master **GitHub Issues** (actionable tasks and bug reports), **Discussions** (open-ended ideation), and the **Feature Branch Workflow** used in hackathons.
why_it_matters: Without issue tracking, bugs are forgotten and teams end up duplicating work. Learning how to link issues to Pull Requests using auto-close keywords (`Closes #42`) creates an automated, professional project board.
practical_activity_preview: Open a structured bug/feature issue on GitHub, link it to a PR using `Closes #1`, and watch it close automatically.
